long_biography.plain_text:
Location is the organising principle behind Abbas Sajwani's property work. He selects scarce sites with water views, privacy and access to Dubai's amenities, then develops limited collections around those attributes. Starting with four villa makeovers established his company's boutique model before it moved into ground-up development.

Sajwani follows projects closely while giving specialists autonomy and resources. Client feedback shapes individual homes, while collaborations with outside architects and interior designers give each scheme a distinct architectural language. One Canal translated that method into a waterfront tower, while One Crescent adapted it to a low-rise Palm address. Each retained the emphasis on privacy, location and a small number of residences.
